issues: Minor visual collision: the section heading 'EVOLUÇÃO' is drawn at chartY - 3 while drawLineChart draws its internal 'Peso (kg)' title at chartY - 2 — they render on top of each other producing a smudged look. Suggest either raise the section heading (chartY - 6) OR remove the redundant 'Peso (kg)' from the section that already has 'EVOLUÇÃO' + Peso (kg) label at same line.

Helvetica (jspdf default) does not include Greek Σ / Δ. As a result, the INDICADORES header shows '£ 8 preg' (truncated) instead of 'Σ 8 pregas' and OBJETIVO shows spaced-out 'Δ peso'. Pre-existing issue outside review scope but visible in the generated report — recommend registering a Unicode TTF (e.g., DejaVuSans) via doc.addFileToVFS / doc.addFont for future improvement.

critical_code_review_comments: pdf.js is ~747 lines and mixes 3 distinct exports (dashboard, team-goals, athlete). Consider splitting into /lib/pdf/dashboard.js /lib/pdf/teamGoals.js /lib/pdf/athlete.js + shared /lib/pdf/common.js (drawHeader/drawFooter/fitContain).
fetchPhotoAsDataUrl is called sequentially inside a for-loop for the 3 photos — could be parallelised with Promise.all to speed up PDF generation on slow connections.

The Σ 8 unit inconsistency (fixed everywhere except line 476) is a textbook case for a shared helper like formatSoma8(v) => v == null ? '—' : `${Math.round(v)} mm`. Recommend introducing such helper to avoid future divergence.
